Kickoffs and TV from the team's schedule hub; gate times from the stadium's events page. Week 17 (Rams) is listed by the team as Sun. Jan. 3 with kickoff TBD.

- **Tampa Bay Rowdies**: the last 3 regular-season home matches at `al-lang-stadium` plus the Oct 30 Eastern Conference Quarterfinal the club lists at Al Lang (tentative, opponent TBD).
- **Tampa Bay Sun FC**: 6 fall home matches at `suncoast-credit-union-field` (the club's fall 2026 schedule; spring 2027 not posted).
- **Tampa Bay Rays**: ALDS Games 1, 2 and 5 (if necessary) at `tropicana-field` (MLB's tentative postseason schedule: "AL 4/5 Winner plays TB"), 3 spring games at Tropicana Field (Mar 20, 21, 23, 2027) and all 19 regular-season home games from the Mar 25, 2027 opener through Apr 29. Times not yet set.
- **Spring training 2027** (the schedules are published): every home game for the Yankees (16, `george-m-steinbrenner-field`), Phillies (16, `baycare-ballpark`), Blue Jays (15, `td-ballpark`), Pirates (16, `lecom-park`) and Tigers (15, `publix-field-at-joker-marchant-stadium`), all "game time not yet announced". Orioles (`ed-smith-stadium`) and Braves (`cooltoday-park`) are series records only.
- **Minor league (Florida State League, Single-A)**: 2027 home openers and a series record for the Tampa Tarpons, Clearwater Threshers, Dunedin Blue Jays, Bradenton Marauders and Lakeland Flying Tigers.
- **Bowls**: Gasparilla Bowl (Dec 18, 2:30 p.m.) and ReliaQuest Bowl (Dec 31, 2026, noon; SEC vs. Big Ten; $170 club / $80 other seats), plus the ReliaQuest Bowl Parade in Ybor City (Dec 30) and Clearwater Beach Day (Dec 29), both tentative per the bowl's own caveat.
- **Racing and motorsports**: Tampa Bay Downs Opening Day (Nov 18), Festival Preview Day 47 (Feb 6), Festival Day 47, the Tampa Bay Derby card (Mar 6, featured), Florida Cup Day (Apr 4); Firestone Grand Prix of St. Petersburg 2027 (tentative on Mar 6, the only published date) and its Race the Track 5K (Mar 4); Monster Jam at Raymond James (Feb 13 and 14).
- **Runs**: Publix Gasparilla Distance Classic 2027 (Feb 19-21, the 50th running, per-race start times), Clearwater Marathon & Running Festival (Jan 30-31), SKECHERS Hot Chocolate Run Tampa (Dec 13).
- **Other one-offs**: TNA Bound for Glory (Oct 11, Yuengling Center), the 32nd Tampa Am skateboarding contest (Oct 15-18), HYROX Tampa (Oct 22-25, Tampa Convention Center), A-Class Catamaran World Championships (Nov 5-14, Davis Island Yacht Club).
- **Series (27)**: one per team season (Lightning, Bucs, USF football, USF basketball, Rowdies, Sun, Rays, 7 spring-training clubs, 5 minor league clubs) and one per annual event (Gasparilla Bowl, ReliaQuest Bowl, Grand Prix, Valspar Championship, Tampa Bay Downs season, Gasparilla Distance Classic, Clearwater Marathon, Tampa Am).

Counts. By kind: sports 199, run-walk 4, parade 1. By status: scheduled 198, tentative 6. By month: Oct 23, Nov 25, Dec 21, Jan 7, Feb 38, Mar 68, Apr 22. By area: channel-district 43, west-tampa 38, grand-central 25, bradenton-anna-maria 17, downtown-clearwater 17, dunedin 16, polk 16, north-tampa 15, downtown-stpete 6, oldsmar 4, and one each in east-tampa, downtown-tampa, davis-islands, clearwater-beach, ybor-city, sand-key, hyde-park. 68 events have a published start time; the rest carry `time_text` ("Game time not yet announced", "Tip time TBA", "Kickoff time TBA") or per-day `occurrences`.

## How candidates were found

WebSearch was not available in this session (the session's search budget was already used up), so discovery ran on official pages and feeds opened directly:
- Team and league sources: the NHL schedule feed (api-web.nhle.com) and nhl.com/lightning news releases; buccaneers.com schedule and schedule-release hub; gousfbulls.com schedule pages (data read from the page's embedded Nuxt payload); rowdiessoccer.com and tampabaysunfc.com schedules; MLB Stats API schedules (the data behind every mlb.com and milb.com schedule page) plus mlb.com team spring-training pages and the MLB postseason schedule page.
- Venue calendars: raymondjamesstadium.com/events (Bucs, USF, bowls, Monster Jam, gate times); tampabaydowns.com (admission page, racing-calendar script, 2026-27 calendar PDF).
- The Tampa Bay Sports Commission's composite calendars for 2026 and 2027 (tampabaysports.org), whose preview links led to TNA, Tampa Am, HYROX, the A-Class Worlds and the Hot Chocolate Run.
- Visit Tampa Bay's sports page (confirms the team list and that the Tarpons are the Yankees' Single-A affiliate) and events page.
- Organizer sites: gasparillabowl.com, reliaquestbowl.com, gpstpete.com, indycar.com, valsparchampionship.com, rungasparilla.com, millenniumrunning.com/cw, hotchocolate15k.com, skateparkoftampa.com, hyrox.com, aclassworlds.com, tnawrestling.com.
- `source_url` is the page or feed that states the facts. Where the human page is rendered by script (mlb.com, milb.com, nhl.com schedules), `source_url` is the official JSON feed (statsapi.mlb.com or api-web.nhle.com) and the human schedule page is in `url` and `also_sources`.
- Coordinates: only three events carry their own (Tampa Am, A-Class Worlds, Hot Chocolate Run: OpenStreetMap/Photon features, noted in `notes`); every other event uses a `place` id from venues-bay, outdoors, see-tampa, see-pinellas or the shared list (`ybor-city-historic-district`).

## Deliberately left out, and why

- Individual Orioles and Braves spring games (Sarasota County day trips): series records only. Rays home spring games at Charlotte Sports Park, Port Charlotte: outside this guide's areas.
- The other ~58 April minor league home games: home openers and series records only, to keep What's On readable.
- Youth and amateur tournaments on the Sports Commission calendar (soccer, lacrosse, volleyball, flag football, youth hockey, trap shooting, cheer, Tropical 7s rugby on Mar 25-28, 2027) and the American Tipoff media day (Oct 11-12, JW Marriott Tampa Water Street): not spectator events for visitors.
- Florida Gold Coast horse show (Dec 27-31, 2026, Florida State Fairgrounds, per anequineproduction.com): a participant show with no spectator information.
- Concerts at Raymond James (Karol G, Ed Sheeran, Usher, Kenny Chesney) belong to events-shows; Hondo Rodeo Fest (Feb 26-28) is in events-spring.
- Valspar Championship: May 3-9, 2027, after the window; series record only. St. Pete Marathon: debuts in December 2027, outside the window.
- USF men's basketball vs. Saint Leo (Oct 19): the schedule marks it with a non-regular game type ("S") and does not say whether it is a public exhibition.
- Possible ALCS and World Series home games, the American Conference football championship (Dec 5, host TBD) and NFL/NHL playoffs: not scheduled.

## Gaps and open questions for the verifier

1. Benchmark International Arena and Yuengling Center event calendars returned bot challenges, and Visit St. Pete/Clearwater's events pages returned 403, so arena-only one-offs (college basketball events, WWE, figure skating, etc.) may be missing. The Sports Commission lists an "Orion180 Insurance Tip-Off Classic" on Nov 2, 2026 (Ticketmaster page, 403) and "American Conference Men's/Women's Basketball Tournament" on Mar 9-14, 2027 with no venue; neither was confirmed, so neither is recorded.
2. Not found or not yet published: a 2027 Supercross date in Tampa (none on the Raymond James calendar through Apr 24, 2027); the Skyway 10K 2027 date; St. Anthony's Triathlon (site unreachable); St. Pete Run Fest (domain parked); spring 2027 Tampa Bay Sun dates; USF conference basketball dates; IndyCar's 2027 calendar and the Grand Prix's full 2027 weekend; USF baseball and softball 2027 (not checked).

4. `tampa-bay-downs-festival-day-2027`: the 2027 calendar says "Festival Day 47"; that it is the Tampa Bay Derby card rests on the 2026 entry (Festival Day 46 featured the 46th Tampa Bay Derby) and the admission page's "Tampa Bay Derby Day" price. The 2027 stakes schedule is not posted.
5. ReliaQuest Bowl kickoff: the bowl's about page and the stadium say 12:00 PM; the bowl's schedule-of-events page says 12:03 PM. Stored 12:00.
